items.subject: mRNA-1273 Drug Substance manufacturing
items.statement: Manufacturing process consists of six sequential steps: mRNA Synthesis at 37.6°C using T7 RNA Polymerase IVT, mRNA Purification using Tangential Flow Filtration at ≤5°C, LNP Formulation using Microfluidic Mixing at 35 mL/min flow rate, Diafiltration with Buffer Exchange to PBS at ≤5°C, Sterile Filtration using 0.22 µm filter at ambient temperature, and Fill-Finish with vial filling of 0.5 mL in Aseptic ISO 5 conditions. All steps resulted in PASS status.
items.supporting_quote: Step 1: mRNA Synthesis, T7 RNA Polymerase IVT, 37.6°C, PASS; Step 2: mRNA Purification, Tangential Flow Filtration, ≤5°C, PASS; Step 3: LNP Formulation, Microfluidic Mixing, Flow rate: 35 mL/min, PASS; Step 4: Diafiltration, Buffer Exchange to PBS, ≤5°C, PASS; Step 5: Sterile Filtration, 0.22 µm filter, Ambient, PASS; Step 6: Fill-Finish, Vial filling (0.5 mL), Aseptic ISO 5, PASS
items.steps: ["mRNA Synthesis using T7 RNA Polymerase IVT at 37.6°C", "mRNA Purification using Tangential Flow Filtration at ≤5°C", "LNP Formulation using Microfluidic Mixing at flow rate 35 mL/min", "Diafiltration with Buffer Exchange to PBS at ≤5°C", "Sterile Filtration using 0.22 µm filter at ambient temperature", "Fill-Finish with vial filling of 0.5 mL in Aseptic ISO 5 conditions"]

items.subject: mRNA-1273 Drug Substance Batch BN-21776-710 in-process controls
items.statement: All in-process control parameters passed specifications: pH 7.04 (spec 6.8–7.2), Osmolality 305 mOsm/kg (spec 250–350), Particle Size Z-avg 89 nm (spec 80–120 nm), Encapsulation Efficiency 89.7% (spec ≥85%), Endotoxin 0.70 EU/mL (spec <5 EU/mL), Sterility no growth at 14 days (spec no growth)
